metric.name: APFS ATTR_VOL_SPACEUSED minus each empty-volume baseline

metric.idle_endpoint: At least 30 seconds inactive, then full volume flush and five stable allocation samples.
metric.sampled_peaks: Background allocator samples with a one-second requested interval; query overhead lengthens the period. These are lower bounds on transient maxima.

session.description: Replay three recent committed checkpoints from Ruff PR #27736: simplify recursive attribute inference, index its dependencies per class, and infer component fixed points. Use the focused mdtests and affected-package validation commands observed in that development session, with the pinned AGENTS.md development profile and snapshot updates disabled.

Implement a dedicated PyPI Simple API JSON parser, rerun focused parser and registry-client tests, then simplify the parser and its compatibility tests. Apply the same versioned runtime binary-path setup fix to the baseline and first-edit donor for both compilers; preserve every original parser change.

design.interpretation: Paired whole-configuration comparisons against stock Rust; not a controlled comparison between Ohm releases or nine independent developer histories.
